entries.summary: Mirage maps IsEnabled explicitly so browser-native time-input interaction remains deterministic across runtime hosts.
Mirage currently supports browser-native hh:mm and hh:mm:ss projection depth; full MAUI custom format breadth remains deterministic subset behavior in this wave.

Mirage does not infer IsOpen=true from raw focus events because browser focus does not reliably indicate native picker UI visibility; successful programmatic open requests are the strongest browser signal available, and close reconciliation still comes from change/blur.
